subject: Order Form — invoicing timing, tax gross-up, and payment phasing appendix
messages:
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@novamed.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Order form redlines + invoicing cadence

Kim — thanks for the draft Order Form. Procurement reviewed and we have a few outstanding items before we can route to payments: 

- Net terms: Novamed requests Net 60 (we're a public healthcare org; finance cycles require 60 days)
- Invoicing cadence: prefer quarterly invoices aligned to our fiscal quarter, but open to monthly billing if you can provide a monthly true-up/credit mechanism (we must avoid double-billing around ramp)
- Activation invoice: need confirmation whether the activation invoice is due at signature or at go-live (our system needs the invoice to match the activation milestone)
- Taxes: we will apply reverse charge in country; we need clear Order Form language that Redwood will not gross-up without supplier evidence. If withholding applies, Novamed can provide withholding certificates but only after payment — can you confirm acceptable evidence and timing?
- PO attached (Novamed_PO_45321.pdf) — please confirm remit entity and currency.

Can you share a redline and a short payment phasing appendix that we can attach to the Order Form? We aim to finish legal/procurement review by next Wednesday 6/17.

Regards,
Sarah
Procurement Manager | Novamed

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@novamed.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form redlines + invoicing cadence

Hi Sarah — thank you, and appreciate the PO. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Lauren (legal) so we can align quickly. Quick responses to your bullets below plus next steps: 

- Net terms: Redwood standard is Net 45. We can escalate Net 60 to finance leadership where required; request: a cleared PO + signed Order Form to trigger Net 60 review. I'll confirm with finance by Monday.
- Invoicing cadence & true-up: proposed approach in the attached "payment_phasing_appendix_draft.docx":
  * Activation invoice: equal to the first 3 months of committed minimum (billed on sign) OR option B: invoice at go-live if you prefer sign != go-live. Please confirm preference.
  * Ongoing billing: monthly invoices with a quarterly reconciliation/true-up so amounts billed align to actual usage and avoid double-billing around ramp and proration. If you must have quarterly invoices only, we can produce consolidated quarterly invoices but require a 10-business-day lead for processing and quarterly settlement terms.
- Taxes/gross-up: we propose explicit appendix language that customer is responsible for withholding; if customer provides valid governmental withholding certificates within 30 days of payment, Redwood will invoice net of withholding. If not provided, Redwood reserves the right to gross-up or invoice for the shortfall. Lauren will propose precise wording.
- Currency/remit: can you confirm the remit entity on the PO (entity name & tax id) and preferred invoice currency (USD or EUR)? If invoice currency != payment currency, we'll add a FX clause for adjustments.

I've attached: payment_phasing_appendix_draft.docx and payment_matrix_v3.xlsx (shows sample flows). Ben — any commercial constraints we should flag? Lauren — can you take the lead on the tax/gross-up clause?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Order Management | Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@novamed.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form redlines + invoicing cadence

Sarah / team — quick commercial notes from sales/finance perspective: 

- We can accommodate Net 60 for Novamed given the size and strategic fit, conditional on the activation invoice being issued at signature and a confirmed PO number (Novamed_PO_45321). That ensures cashflow timing.
- If Net 60 is required and we invoice post-go-live, we need a small mitigation: either a 1.0% timing fee (one-time) or an additional 30 days credit charge on late balances. I'd prefer to keep this simple — a 1.0% one-time timing fee added to the activation invoice would be the least operationally complex. Open to waiver if leadership approves.
- For quarterly-only invoicing: we can do it, but it increases month-end reconciliation workload. Monthly invoices with quarterly reconciliation keeps bookkeeping clean for both sides.
- Currency: Novamed's PO is in EUR but our standard is USD. We accept EUR invoicing if you can provide a EUR remit bank and indicate FX responsibility (we recommend customer bears FX risk).

I'll hold on final pricing until we confirm whether leadership signs off on Net 60 without timing fee.

Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form redlines + invoicing cadence — legal redlines attached

Sarah / Kim / Ben — attached are suggested tracked redlines for the Order Form and a discrete clause we propose adding to the Terms: the "Tax & Withholding" paragraph within the Payment Phasing Appendix. Key legal points below (high level):

1) Tax responsibility: Customer shall be responsible for all taxes imposed on payments to Redwood other than Redwood's income taxes. If Customer is required by law to withhold or deduct taxes, Customer shall provide timely official withholding certificates or government receipts within 30 days of payment.

2) Gross-up and remedies: If Customer fails to provide acceptable documentation within 30 days, Redwood may either (a) invoice Customer for the amount necessary to ensure Redwood receives the net amount it would have received absent withholding; or (b) suspend performance until evidence is provided. We purposely include the suspension remedy as a last resort.

3) Net terms language: we will capture Net 60 as an exception in an Order Form appendix with explicit approval path: approval by Redwood VP Finance required (email to finance@redwood.ai suffices) and activation invoice must be issued at signature to qualify.

4) Invoice timing & reconciliation: legal prefers a single canonical clause that says: "Invoices are issued monthly unless Customer requests consolidated quarterly invoicing in writing at least 10 business days prior to the quarter-end. Monthly invoices will be subject to quarterly reconciliation adjustments to true-up usage/proration." That avoids duplicative language scattered across documents.

I can produce redlines in tracked changes (docx) and a clean annex for execution. Also added optional language for FX: if invoice is issued in USD and payment is made in EUR, Customer bears FX variance on the invoice date.

Attachments: OrderForm_Redlines_LB_v1.docx (tracked), Payment_Phasing_Appendix_LB_v1.docx

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
